name: oncoplan
description: OncoPlan – Remote Patient Monitoring für die Onkologie (Patienten-PWA + Ärzte-Dashboard)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run db:push && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test -- --watch=false
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
